title: 第11章 开脉第12章 一头猪
content_zh:
;;
渝州城外，朝阳升起，李子夜徒步走来，一身露水，狼狈异常。
整整一夜，李子夜方才走了回来。
得罪女人，还是秦婀娜这样厉害的女人，后果甚是悲惨。
李府，李子夜一夜未归，李百万急的团团转，只是，碍于后院湖边的恐怖女人，什么也不敢做。
“不用问，也不必找，他死不了！”昨夜，秦婀娜回来时，只说了一句话，便回了自己的房间休息。
李百万心急，却也只能干着急，不敢说也不敢问。
“老爷，公子回来了。”
前院，一位下人匆匆走来，禀报道。
李百万闻言，赶忙上前迎接。
府前，衣衫褴褛，头发凌乱，仿佛乞丐一般的李子夜走了回来，让府中所有人都惊了。
公子这是怎么了？
为何看起来像是被人糟蹋了一般？
“儿子，儿子你没事吧？”
看到宝贝儿子回来，李百万赶忙上前，问道。
“我这像是没事吗？”
李子夜伸出双臂，指了指自己的模样，没好气道，“就是还没死罢了。”
说完，李子夜左右看了看，怒道，“老秦呢，回来了吗？”
“在后院。”
李百万回答道。

“我去找她！”
李子夜气冲冲地说了一句，旋即快步走向后院。
“儿子，别冲动，你打不过她！”
后方，李百万一惊，赶忙拽住前者，提醒道。
李子夜闻言，身子一滞，面露悲愤之色。
他堂堂李府三公子，这世上最有钱的纨绔子弟，开挂的穿越者，天道的亲儿子，竟然会怕一个女人！
不是说，穿越必无敌吗？
肥皂他发明了，琉璃他也造出来了，眼看所有的一切都在按照剧本发展，为何，为何却让他八脉堵塞，无法习武。
这不是玩人吗！
“儿子，有什么话好好说，那女人实在太厉害。”李百万很是忌惮地安慰道。
“老李，你真没出息，一个女人让你怕成这样！”
李子夜收拾好心情，一脸鄙视地看了一眼身后的李胖子，旋即昂首挺胸朝着后院走去。
李百万神色一怔，旋即回过神，赶忙跟上去。
儿子今天这么强硬，难道是要和秦仙子正面冲突？
后院湖边，秦婀娜静立，目光看着湖面，神色如平静的湖水一般不带丝毫波澜。
一旁，张邋遢依旧懒洋洋地躺在那里，喝着酒，好不自在。
这时，后院外，李子夜大步流星地走了过来，昂首挺胸，气势如虹，纵然一身狼狈，亦难掩无畏无惧的气质。
“哟，这小子还算有几分骨气！”
张邋遢睁开眼睛，看着气势冲冲的李子夜，赞赏道。
打！打起来！

他老头子最喜欢看热闹了。
近了！
content_en:
;;
Outside Yuzhou City, the morning sun rose, and Li Ziye walked on foot, covered with dew and looking extremely embarrassed.
After a whole night, Li Ziye just came back.
Offending a woman, even a powerful woman like Qin Wanna, would have very tragic consequences.
Li Mansion, Li Zi did not return all night, and Li Wanwan was anxiously running around, but he did not dare to do anything because of the scary woman by the lake in the backyard.
"No need to ask, no need to look for him, he can't die!" When Qin Grace came back last night, she only said one sentence and went back to her room to rest.
Li Wanwan was anxious, but he could only act anxiously, not daring to say or ask.
"Master, the young master is back."
In the front yard, a servant came hurriedly to report.
Hearing this, Li Baiwan hurried forward to greet him.
In front of the house, Li Ziye, who was in ragged clothes and with messy hair, looking like a beggar, came back, surprising everyone in the house.
Sir, what's going on?
Why does it look like it was ruined?
"Son, son, are you okay?"
Seeing his precious son coming back, Li Baiwan hurried forward and asked.
"Do I seem to be okay?"
Li Ziye stretched out his arms, pointed at his appearance, and said angrily, "He's just not dead yet."
After saying that, Li Ziye looked around and said angrily, "Where's Lao Qin, are you back?"
"In the backyard."
Li Wanwan replied.
"I'll go find her!"
Li Ziye said angrily and quickly walked to the backyard.
"Son, don't be impulsive, you can't beat her!"
Behind him, Li Baiwan was startled and quickly grabbed the former and reminded him.
When Li Ziye heard this, his body froze, and his face showed sadness and anger.
He, the dignified third son of the Li family, the richest dandy in the world, a cheating time traveler, and the biological son of Tiandao, was actually afraid of a woman!
Didn’t it mean that you would be invincible if you traveled through time?
He invented soap and made glass. Seeing that everything was developing according to the script, why, why did his eight meridians become blocked and he was unable to practice martial arts.
Isn’t this playing tricks on people?
"Son, if you have anything to say, please tell me. That woman is really powerful." Li Baiwan comforted him with fear.
"Old Li, you are really worthless, a woman makes you so afraid!"
Li Ziye gathered his mood, glanced at Fatty Li behind him with contempt, and then walked toward the backyard with his head held high.
Li Wanwan looked stunned for a moment, then came to his senses and hurriedly followed.
If my son is so tough today, is he going to have a head-on conflict with Fairy Qin?
By the lake in the backyard, Qin Grace stood quietly, looking at the lake with an expression as calm as the lake without any ripples.
Beside, Zhang Sloppy was still lying there lazily, drinking wine, feeling very uncomfortable.
At this time, outside the backyard, Li Ziye strode over with his head held high and his momentum like a rainbow. Even though he was in a state of embarrassment, he could not hide his fearless temperament.
"Hey, this kid still has some backbone!"
Zhang Sloppy opened his eyes, looked at Li Ziye who was full of energy, and praised him.
beat! Fight!
His old man likes to watch the fun the most.
Close!
